seo_title: Avondale Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 2 Events, 1 Free
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Avondale, AZ: Winterfest at the Civic Center with Santa selfies and a train ride, plus the Avondazzle light display.
lede: Avondale celebrates with a Winterfest at the Civic Center, Santa selfies, a train ride under artificial snow and the Avondazzle holiday light display.
celebrates: Avondale's holiday season centers on the Civic Center Campus. The City of Avondale hosts Winterfest, a free evening with Santa selfies, a train ride under the snowfall, crafts, inflatables and the premiere of the season's light show. After Winterfest, the Avondazzle Holiday Light Display opens nightly in front of City Hall with a synchronized Christmas tree show every 30 minutes, and a second display lights up Old Town Avondale. The city encourages guests to bring a blanket or chair and their own treats to enjoy the show.
lastyear: Avondazzle debuted in 2025, according to local coverage, as the city's new holiday light display with a synchronized tree lighting and extended festivities at the Avondale Civic Center. A City of Avondale video invited residents to visit the Civic Center Complex and watch the city Christmas tree light up the night every 30 minutes. The city says the 2026 season returns with Arizona Public Service as the presenting sponsor and a supporting sponsor, Semper Fi Heating and Cooling.
facts: Avondazzle's holiday light show plays every 30 minutes, with the first show at 5:30 pm and the last at 9:30 pm, according to the city's event page. The display sits in front of City Hall at the Avondale Civic Center, 11465 West Civic Center Drive. Civic Center Park next door has open turf, a fenced playground and a lighted walking path, so families can stretch out on a blanket and let children play between shows.
trains: Avondale has no holiday railroad of its own, but Winterfest brings a kid sized train ride to the Civic Center. For longer train outings, maricopa Live Steamers in Glendale runs free Holiday Lights Train Rides on select evenings, and our Glendale page lists the dates. The Arizona Railway Museum in Chandler displays historic railroad cars, and McCormick-Stillman Railroad Park in Scottsdale has model trains and a miniature railroad.

faq: Avondazzle is the City of Avondale's holiday light display at the Avondale Civic Center and Old Town Avondale. It features a synchronized Christmas tree show every 30 minutes, with the first show at 5:30 pm and the last at 9:30 pm. The city is the host, and Arizona Public Service presents it.

The City of Avondale lists Winterfest at the Civic Center as a free community evening, with Santa selfies, a train ride under the snowfall, crafts, inflatables and the premiere of the light show. Check the city's page for hours and any activity fees before you plan your evening.
What should we bring to Avondazzle?

The city suggests bringing a blanket or chair, along with your own treats, so you can settle in front of City Hall and enjoy the synchronized show. Civic Center Park next door has a fenced playground and a lighted walking path for children who need to move.
Is there a train ride in Avondale?

Winterfest includes a train ride at the Civic Center. For other options, Maricopa Live Steamers in Glendale runs free Holiday Lights Train Rides on select evenings, and the Arizona Railway Museum in Chandler has historic railroad cars that families can tour year round.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Avondale for 2026, and here is what he found: 2 family events, 1 of them free. The magic runs from December 5 (Winterfest at Avondale Civic Center) through January 1, 2027 (Avondazzle Holiday Light Display), with the synchronized tree show at Avondazzle every 30 minutes along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Avondale

  • 1 free event: Winterfest at Avondale Civic Center with Santa selfies and a train ride
  • Lights: Avondazzle at the Civic Center and Old Town Avondale, nightly from December 6
  • Season: December 5, 2026 to January 1, 2027
